title: LIVE, TEST and DEVELOPMENT as namespace generations
summary: LIVE, TEST and DEVELOPMENT are environment projections over versioned storage objects rather than obligatorily duplicated directory trees. TEST/DEV can inherit immutable LIVE refs and diverge through change-set overlays.
invariants: Default route policy is VERSIONED for LIVE, COPY_ON_WRITE for TEST and TRACKED for DEVELOPMENT.
A TEST/DEV write must not mutate the LIVE base without an explicit promotion/merge operation.
Environment generations and change-set evidence are restart-persistent.
Promotion is generation-pinned: stale target generations fail preflight instead of silently rebasing.
Sharing immutable source objects across environments does not imply policy permission to expose restricted LIVE data to TEST/DEV.

provenance.claim: Regression proves LIVE/TEST overlay semantics and generation-pinned promotion.
Regression proves restart-persistent environment and change-set evidence.
